regions.label: text_block
regions.text: I went down  yesterday to the Piraeus with Glaucon the son of Ariston, that I might offer up my prayers to the goddess; and also because I wanted to see in what manner they would celebrate the festival, which was a new thing.

regions.label: note_area
regions.text: The festival of Bendis, a Thracian goddess identified with Artemis; this is its first recorded celebration at the Piraeus.
